project_info.name: Engraved Word
project_info.description: High-precision real-time video workspace and meeting platform. Combines architectural precision and warm tactile typography with cinematic dark-mode video call environments.

tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS + custom index.css CSS variables
tech_stack.toasts: sonner (located in src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or imported from sonner)

typography.heading_font: Outfit, 'Cabinet Grotesk', sans-serif (DO NOT use Inter for headings)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, 'Source Code Pro', monospace (For room codes, timers, latencies, participant counts)

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing system (p-6, p-8, p-12) to create breathing room. All containers with borders MUST have interior padding.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: The Tetris Grid for landing pages; High-Density Grid for participant video grids and meeting controls.
layout_and_spacing.border_styles: 1px sharp solid borders with subtle low-opacity colors (border-slate-800/80). Glassmorphism controls: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800/60.

landing_page.hero_section: Bold asymmetric layout with headline 'Engraved Word — High-Fidelity Video Meetings', quick room creation card, direct room code join input, live meeting preview mockup.
landing_page.features_grid: 3-column bento style with grid borders exposing the precision framework: Zero-lag spatial audio, dynamic tile grid, encrypted room tokens, real-time transcript.
landing_page.header_nav: Sticky glassmorphic top navigation with logo symbol, 'Features', 'Security', 'Host Sign In' modal trigger, and 'Instant Call' primary button.

pre_join_lobby.container: Split view or centered studio card. Left side: Video feed preview box with mic audio level visualization bar, mirror toggle, camera selector. Right side: Display name input, audio/video device toggles, 'Join Room' CTA button.

in_meeting_room.video_grid: Adaptive viewport grid (1 to 9+ participants) supporting responsive grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. Active speaker border glow (ring-2 ring-amber-500/80). Local video camera preview card (pinned bottom right or integrated).
in_meeting_room.control_bar: Floating bottom pill container: Mic Toggle, Camera Toggle, Screen Share Toggle, Active Participant List toggle (with badge count), Chat Panel toggle, Copy Room Code button, Destructive Leave Call button.
in_meeting_room.side_panel: Collapsible slide-over drawer for Real-Time Text Chat with timestamps + Participant list with host actions (Mute participant, Pin video, Kick participant).

studio_workspace_backgrounds.description: Modern dark architectural office background for landing hero

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, chat forms, leave call buttons) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute. Examples: data-testid="create-meeting-btn", data-testid="join-room-input", data-testid="toggle-mic-btn", data-testid="toggle-cam-btn", data-testid="send-chat-btn", data-testid="copy-link-btn".
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rule: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Never rely on transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build full .js / .jsx components for Engraved Word.

Implement real-time interactive simulation or WebRTC video streaming hooks with local webcam preview (using navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) when available, falling back smoothly to avatar/video cards.
Include Sonner toast notifications for events like 'Room code copied', 'User joined call', 'Mic muted'.
Maintain the architectural dark obsidian and copper theme across landing, lobby, and in-call states.
